stories.title: RentTech companies asking tenants for personal details ‘completely outside’ new Victorian laws

stories.title: Hamas Releases Four Female Israeli Soldiers Under Gaza Cease-Fire Deal
stories.summary: Hamas released four female Israeli soldiers under a multiphase Gaza ceasefire agreement. They were the second group of hostages freed since the deal took effect, raising hopes that the agreement could lead to a lasting end to the war.

links.headline: Hamas Releases Four Female Israeli Soldiers Under Gaza Cease-Fire Deal
links.excerpt: The hostages are the second set to be released since the multiphase agreement came into effect, raising hopes for a lasting end to the war.

stories.title: Shippers Wary of Red Sea Routes Despite Houthi Pledge to End Targeting
stories.summary: Major container shippers remain wary of returning to Red Sea routes despite a Houthi pledge to stop targeting vessels. The world's three largest container operators said instability in Gaza and broader regional tensions continued to pose a danger.

links.headline: Shippers Wary of Red Sea Routes Despite Houthi Pledge to End Targeting
links.excerpt: The world’s top three container operators said they fear instability in Gaza and broader regional tensions mean continued danger.
